LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_DecoyOpened: A gilded decoy! The shiny chest contains ordinary metal. The real cache may be elsewhere.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_ChestRemaining: Opened. Some contents remain inside: clear a space and collect them.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_ChestSealed: Sealed. Select a colonist and right-click the chest to open it.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_SiteLimit: requires a colony and fewer than four active expeditions
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_NoSiteTile: No suitable treasure site was found. The map was not consumed.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_DefaultClue: Evidence of traps and decoy caches. Inspect the area before opening anything.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TemporarySite: This is a temporary expedition. The site closes after your entire party leaves. Take all desired loot before departing.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_SiteLetter: Coordinates of a possible treasure site have been discovered. Expected danger: {0}/5. Guards, traps and decoys may be present. Look for notes and traces of earlier visitors.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_DiscardLeadDescription: Remove an unvisited lead to make room for another expedition.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_DiscardLeadConfirmation: Discard the lead to {0}? The site will be removed from the world map. A consumed treasure map will not be refunded.
